source_text: Amici mei et proximi mei adversum me appropinquaverunt et steterunt. Fidelis infirmus mugit pro delictis; conscientia accusatrix mecum est — cur exspecto accusatorem?
pass_a_gloss: My friends and neighbors drew near against me and stood. The faithful weak man groans for faults; conscience the accuser is with me — why wait for an accuser?
pass_b_english: [[My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague >> Bible:Psalm 38:11]]. Better a weak believer who confesses than one who hides — conscience already prosecutes; [[all things are naked before him >> Bible:Hebrews 4:13]].
